pronunciation.control_boundary: Dictionary and occurrence targets are acceptance criteria. Native Qwen Base does not consume IPA or SSML. The normalization below carries the spoken forms the previous ETHOS film adopted after heard errors; no further normalization is proposed without an actually heard error.

sources.qualification: First returned single-character sense is not a universal reading.

Chinese.sandhi: Natural Mandarin connected-speech tone sandhi and weak grammatical syllables; never force isolated citation tones.
Chinese.target_scope: Every Chinese segment; the embedded English names are spoken as English words inside the Chinese clauses.

acceptance: Listen to every listed occurrence in its complete clause and a short waveform window, including the connected lead-in and natural phrase tail.
Bind actual script and spoken-text hashes, selected reference, generated WAV hash, exact time window, target, observation, listener/modality and decision.
ASR spelling, alignment, F0, dictionary targets and model praise alone cannot certify pronunciation or natural flow.
Qualify raw complete paragraphs, assembled within-chapter joins and chapter boundaries separately. No isolated-word splice or forced overall speed.
Full-film bilingual listening remains required after a pilot; targets are not a claim that all words were heard.
